Updated Tue, September 22, 2026 at 10:56 AM UTC

Discussions about UFOs are not limited to just researchers and UAP experts, as they are something the entire world is curious about. This time, we're focusing on what TV icon Tyler Henry shared during his latest interaction with Jack Osbourne in the new episode of Trying Not to Die on YouTube.

In the episode, Henry talks about an incident that occurred in the Mojave Desert during the day. He and his partner were simply travelling, and they didn't have a particular destination.

The TV icon said that he saw an object, saying:

"...silver balloon looking object that was floating maybe 30 ft above the ground, and I was like, oh, that's weird."

Tyler Henry said that he and his partner noticed a balloon that was silver in color, and it was almost 30 ft. above them. That was the moment he felt was really weird because when he got out of the car to take a video, that object disappeared.

What's even weirder is that initially, the object seemed to be following the couple's car. And once Tyler Henry was out to take a video, he could no longer see that metallic balloon.

More details below!

Tyler Henry recounts a strange incident in the Mojave Desert while talking about UFOs and aliens

Tyler Henry recalled an unusual sighting while driving through the Mojave Desert with his partner in broad daylight. Henry said he spotted a silver object hovering about 30 feet above the ground. To him, it looked somewhat like a weather balloon, although its metallic appearance made it seem different from an ordinary balloon.

Curious about what he was seeing, Henry and his partner turned the car and began driving toward it. He said the object then appeared to move along with their vehicle, and he said:

"And it looked just like a balloon, like a weather balloon, but it was metallic in shape. And so we stopped, and I thought, I have to get this on video. I have to film this. And we got out of the car, we looked, and it had just disappeared just like that."

Henry did not claim that the object was definitely an alien spacecraft. Instead, he said he had no idea what it was, although the timing of its disappearance struck him as particularly strange. He added:

"So, am I saying that's an alien? I have no clue. But it was definitely weird in the timing of it."

Henry continued:

"And a lot of UFO experiencers have spoken to that very idea that the moment they go to capture it, you know, the car breaks down or the camera malfunctions. And so I found myself experiencing that very thing."

He explained that other people who report UFO experiences have described similar difficulties when trying to document what they see. In that sense, his own UFO encounter reminded him of stories involving cameras failing or other unexpected problems occurring at the moment of recording.
